properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. From hxm_program's F-27 (AJ's work session, 2026-09-23): "A `loop_status`/`sync` note when a committed export has no `merge=reflow2` attribute (checkable with `git check-attr`) would catch it."

THE GAP IT ANSWERS is root-caused in fact:the-merge-rule-is-written-for-a-conventional-path-once-and-nothing-checks-the-real-export-2026-09-23: the merge rule is written once, at install, for `docs/design/<project>.json`; a project whose export lives elsewhere (hxm_program's `reflow2.json` at the root, its `designs/*/design.json`) or that predates the installer step keeps git's line merge silently.

OPTIONS, NONE CHOSEN:

(a) A USE-TIME CHECK ON THE REAL PATH. For each export `loop_status.sync` already tracks, run `git check-attr merge <path>`; when it is not `reflow2`, one line naming the file and the rule to add. Cheap, reads what reflow2 already knows, and never acts (the requirement it serves forbids acting unasked). ⚠️ Counter: it runs git on every `loop_status`; cacheable on the attribute file's mtime.

(b) A SECOND LINE FOR THE CLONE-SIDE HALF: `merge.reflow2.driver` unset in this clone while an attribute names the export. The attribute travels and the driver cannot, so a correct repo still line-merges on a fresh clone. ⚠️ Counter: the driver path is machine-specific; the line can only say "not configured here", never what to set it to beyond the installed binary.

(c) THE INSTALLER WRITES THE RULE FOR THE PATH THE PROJECT ACTUALLY USES — its `--export-to`, not the convention. Fixes new setups; does nothing for a project that moves its export later, which is why it pairs with (a) rather than replacing it.

(d) DO NOTHING HERE AND BUILD req:the-saved-design-merges-correctly-under-gits-ordinary-merge INSTEAD. Accepted 2026-09-23 and unbuilt: once a design merges correctly under git's ordinary merge, no attribute and no driver are needed and this whole class retires. ⚠️ Counter: it is the larger piece of work by far; (a) is a day's change that protects every project until then.

Honest reading: (a) with (b) is the stopgap, (d) is the cure, and they do not compete.
properties.name: OPEN — should reflow2 say, at use time, when git would line-merge a design's committed export (no merge=reflow2 attribute on it, or no driver configured in this clone)?
